title: Skill Management System
summary: A backend for a skill/CV management web application that seeds a SQL Server database with synthetic Vietnamese employee CV records. Its seed scripts (backend/1000.py, backend/seed_service.py) build a SingleTableMetadata schema and fit an SDV CTGANSynthesizer to generate the synthetic CVs, while a separate gan_service file imports the standalone ctgan package. SDV's CTGAN synthesizer is run directly, via sdv.single_table.CTGANSynthesizer, to fabricate seed data for the application's database.
needs: The standalone `from ctgan import CTGAN` import in backend/gan_service 1.py has no visible call site in the harvested evidence, so its actual use (vs. mere import) is unverified.
